mission.title: Unit 4 Checkpoint: Travel, Culture and Experiences

theory.title: Repaso integrado: viajes y experiencias culturales
theory.explanation: Este punto de control repasa el lenguaje de la Unidad 4 y no introduce gramática nueva. Combina adjetivos descriptivos, expresiones de servicios, conectores narrativos, patrones verbales, adjetivos con preposición, preposiciones de movimiento, phrasal verbs de viaje, peticiones educadas y oraciones de finalidad.
theory.tip: Elige la estructura según la intención: describir, narrar, pedir ayuda o explicar un propósito.

content.passage: Our class travelled to a coastal town to learn about its history. We set off early so that we could arrive before the guided tour. The journey was tiring, but everyone was excited. By the time we reached the harbour, the guide had already prepared the tickets. We walked across the old bridge and looked around the market. One student asked politely where the museum was. In the end, we had a fascinating day and learned a lot about local customs.

items.prompt: Summarise a memorable travel experience using clear sequence markers.
items.modelAnswer: Last spring, I travelled to a small town by train. First, I checked into my hotel and left my bags. Then I explored the old streets and visited a local museum. In the evening, I tried a traditional meal and spoke to the owner about the town's history.

items.prompt: Describe a place that is famous for its culture.
items.modelAnswer: Edinburgh is famous for its historic castle, festivals and old streets. Visitors can walk along the Royal Mile, explore museums and enjoy views from the hills. I like the way the city combines history with a lively cultural scene.

items.prompt: Explain a service you have had done before travelling.
items.modelAnswer: Before travelling, I had my passport photograph updated and arranged travel insurance. I also had my bicycle repaired because I planned to use it at my destination. These services made the trip easier and safer.

items.prompt: Talk about a time you felt excited or exhausted on a journey.
items.modelAnswer: I felt excited when I saw the mountains from the train, but I was exhausted after carrying my bags up several flights of stairs at the hotel. I rested for an hour and then felt ready to explore.

items.prompt: Give polite directions to a visitor.
items.modelAnswer: Excuse me, walk straight ahead from the station and cross the bridge. Turn left at the first traffic lights and continue along the river. The tourist information centre is beside the large square, opposite the café.

items.prompt: Describe a travel problem and how you solved it.
items.modelAnswer: During a city break, our hotel booking could not be found at reception. I showed the confirmation email and contacted the booking service. They checked the reference and arranged a room in the same hotel.

items.prompt: Explain why you choose a particular destination.
items.modelAnswer: I choose a destination based on the kind of break I need. If I want to relax, I prefer a quiet coastal town; if I want to learn something, I choose a city with museums and historic places.

items.prompt: Talk about customs you find interesting.
items.modelAnswer: I'm interested in customs around meals and celebrations. In some places, families prepare special dishes for festivals, while in others people gather in public squares. I enjoy learning the stories behind these traditions.

items.prompt: Recommend a place and explain what visitors can do there.
items.modelAnswer: I recommend visiting the botanical gardens near the river. Visitors can follow different walking paths, see plants from several regions and relax in the café. There are also guided tours at weekends.

items.prompt: Review the most useful language from this unit.
items.modelAnswer: This unit has helped me describe journeys, ask for directions and deal with travel problems politely. I've practised explaining arrangements and talking about customs. I feel more confident asking for help when I am abroad.

content.audioTranscript: A: We are planning a trip next month. B: Where are you going? A: We are travelling to a historic town. B: Have you booked the journey? A: Yes, and we have printed the tickets. B: Which station will you use? A: The central one. B: Is there a local guide? A: Yes, we made a booking online. B: Do you know the platform? A: It is shown on the app. B: What will you visit? A: The museum and the market. B: Are you learning about local customs? A: Yes, and we are staying at a small hotel. B: Enjoy your arrival!
